port.label: Port
port.description: UDP port for this sync zone. Use the same port in your WLED devices' audio sync settings.

latency_ms.label: Light timing (ms)
latency_ms.description: Makes the lights react slightly earlier so they stay in step with your speaker. Increase if the lights lag the music.

gain_db.label: Sensitivity
gain_db.description: How strongly the lights react to the music. Increase if the effects look dim or flat, decrease if they are stuck at maximum.

scaling_mode.label: Light response
scaling_mode.description: How the lights react to quiet and loud parts of the music.

user.title: Add WLED sync zone
user.description: Pick the UDP port for this sync zone. Set the same port on your WLED devices in the AudioReactive sync settings.

manifest.description: Drive WLED's built-in audio-reactive effects from music played by Music Assistant.

errors.port_in_use: This zone port is already used by another WLED instance. Choose a different port.
